text:
sam-sales: Heads-up — customer request inbound for onboarding a new model: Zephyr-6.7B. Private deployment (VPC), wants 4-bit quant (INT4) for cost savings, p95 latency target <120ms, must pass our hallucination/regression suite on finance prompts. Wants initial go-live in ~4 weeks. I attached a redacted prompt set and acceptance criteria in the ticket. Can we triage?

maya: Thanks Sam — can you confirm that we have model weights + license and what format they're in (hf, safetensors, tar)? Also need expected max seq length, typical prompt sizes, and whether the customer expects tool-calling or external plugins. :eyes:

sam-sales: Uploaded to s3://redwood-intakes/zephyr/customerA/weights.tar and s3://redwood-intakes/zephyr/customerA/prompts.tar (redacted). License is permissive (no export restrictions). Typical max seq ~1024, mostly 256-512. No tool-calling initially. Priority: high. Customer will commit to Dedicated capacity if needed.

sasha: Proposed TL;DR checklist for onboarding (short):
- verify license + checksum of weights
- run float32 inference smoke test on a small host
- run PTQ quant sweep (8->6->4) and sanity accuracy checks
- run eval-harness: hallucination detector + extraction correctness + summary fidelity (finance prompts)
- run end-to-end latency bench (single-request p95 sample with and without batching)
- KV cache + prefix-caching profile (if chat-style persists)
- regression alert thresholds and eval dataset commit
- produce canary config for Dedicated/VPC + fallback model mapping

sasha: Quick command for the eval harness (example):

```
python run_eval.py --model s3://redwood-intakes/zephyr/customerA/weights.tar --tasks finance_hallucination,finance_summary --quant 4 --batch 1 --max-seq 512 --out results/zephyr_eval.json
```

liam: From infra side: Dedicated pools currently A100/80GB and A10G. INT4 runs best on A100s for perf predictability; A10G may have higher variance. Need to decide whether we require guaranteed A100 reservations for canary. Also need peak QPS estimate.

sam-sales: Customer expects ~50 qps peak initially, steady 10 qps. Willing to pay for reserved A100 during canary.

maya: I'll own quant experiments and primary regression checks. Plan: PTQ first (8/6/4) using PTQFlow; if quality gaps persist, try QAT on a small subset. Also will run L2 norm checks, embedding drift checks, and a manual pass on edge-case prompts (financial tables).

oliver: Product asks we define acceptance gates:
- hallucination rate <= 2% on our finance hallucination detector
- Rouge-L/F1 drop <= 3% against our baseline (float32 reference)
- p95 latency <120ms at single-request (no batching), and <250ms with 8-request batching as a stress case
- memory/kv behaviour ok for seq=1024 (no OOM in A100 80GB)

sasha: Agree with gates. Also recommend a short regression suite that runs nightly against a stable prompt set; create alerts for any relative quality regression >1% absolute.

liam: Infrastructure TODOs:
- reserve 1x A100 slot for canary for 2 weeks
- schedule dedicated CI job to run eval-harness on the canary cluster
- ensure NVSwitch config supports large kv cache for seq=1024

maya: Quick note on quant plan detail: PTQ pipeline will use 512 calibration steps from the provided prompts (we should check for distribution shift). If PTQ 4-bit is too lossy, QAT on 100k tokens sampled from customer prompts is next.

sam-sales: Uploaded a more complete prompt set to s3://redwood-intakes/zephyr/customerA/prompts_full.tar. Ticket created: MLINTAKE-321 with SLA notes.

infra-bot: auto-note: Created infra request IR-8762 for A100 reservation (pending approval).

sasha: Timing proposal: intake meeting this week (30m). Maya starts PTQ this week; aim for a bench snapshot (accuracy + latency) in 7 days. Canary by week 3, MLP for customer acceptance by week 4.

maya: Owner assignments: Maya = quant + regression owner; Sasha = eval harness + metric gating; Liam = infra + canary provisioning; Sam = customer liaison. I'll spin up initial PTQ runs tonight and post logs.

liam: One more question — do we want to enable continuous batching for cost efficiency? That can change the latency profile; need product decision.

oliver: Product: start with batching disabled for SLA tests. We can enable later with explicit docs on p99 impact.

sam-sales: Thanks team — please add any blockers here. I'll set up intake meeting and invite the customer's technical contact. :thumbsup:

maya: First PTQ run queued. Posting initial artifact link when done. :white_check_mark:
